title: FlightEvent
description: A single aircraft state vector captured from OpenSky Network, enriched with ingestion metadata. This is the contract for messages on the flights.raw Kafka topic.

callsign.description: Callsign of the aircraft (8 chars max). Null if not available.

origin_country.description: Country of origin inferred from ICAO address.

time_position.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last position update.

last_contact.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last contact with the aircraft.

baro_altitude.description: Barometric altitude in meters. Null if not available.

velocity.description: Ground speed in m/s. Null if not available.

true_track.description: True track (heading) in decimal degrees clockwise from north (0-360). Null if not available.

vertical_rate.description: Vertical rate in m/s. Positive = climbing, negative = descending. Null if not available.

geo_altitude.description: Geometric (GPS) altitude in meters. Null if not available.

squawk.description: Transponder squawk code. Null if not available.

spi.description: Whether the Special Purpose Indicator bit is set.

position_source.description: Origin of the position: 0 = ADS-B, 1 = ASTERIX, 2 = MLAT, 3 = FLARM.

on_ground.description: Whether the aircraft is on the ground.

ingestion_ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this message was produced to Kafka.

event_date.description: Date partition key (YYYY-MM-DD) derived from time_position.
